scores.coverage_note: engine v1 runs 42 of the 160-check register; scores reflect assessed checks only

findings.title: No robots.txt file
findings.internal_detail: Publish robots.txt allowing normal crawling and referencing the sitemap URL.
findings.client_summary: The file that guides search engines around the site is missing, so crawling is less efficient than it should be.

findings.title: No XML sitemap at any standard location
findings.internal_detail: Generate and publish an XML sitemap (CMS plugin or build step) and submit it in Search Console.
findings.client_summary: Google is given no list of the site's pages, so discovery depends entirely on following links.

findings.title: The page carries two competing title tags
findings.internal_detail: A second head fragment is embedded in the body (leftover of a pasted template). Remove the duplicate so one title is authoritative.
findings.client_summary: The page gives Google two different names for itself, and Google chooses which to believe.

findings.title: No canonical address declared
findings.evidence: No <link rel="canonical"> in the rendered document
findings.internal_detail: Add a self-referencing canonical to every indexable page.
findings.client_summary: Pages do not declare their official address, which invites duplicate versions into Google's index.

findings.title: Caching disabled for repeat visitors
findings.internal_detail: Serve hashed static assets with long-lived immutable caching; add page/CDN caching where the stack allows.
findings.client_summary: Nothing is stored for returning visitors, so every visit re-downloads everything.

findings.title: Page language is declared as English but reads as Malay
findings.internal_detail: Set the html lang attribute to ms-MY (and add hreflang if an English version exists).
findings.client_summary: The page tells Google it is in English while the content is in Malay, which affects who it is shown to.

findings.title: No meta description
findings.internal_detail: Write a 150-160 character description leading with the primary service and location.
findings.client_summary: Google writes its own snippet for the site instead of showing a chosen message.

findings.title: One page competes for every search
findings.internal_detail: Create a page per service/route/topic so each search need has an indexable URL.
findings.client_summary: A single page can only compete for one kind of search, however good it is.

findings.title: No supporting pages to build authority with
findings.evidence: Site consists of 1 page(s); no service, about, or content pages found
findings.internal_detail: Build out service/about/FAQ pages and supporting content so the site can demonstrate expertise.
findings.client_summary: Beyond the front page there is nothing that shows depth on the subject, which is what search engines reward.

findings.title: 6 image(s) show WhatsApp-transfer filenames
findings.internal_detail: WhatsApp permanently recompresses photos. Re-source originals via email/Drive and replace.
findings.client_summary: Some photos were sent through WhatsApp, which permanently reduces their quality before they ever reach the site.

findings.title: No social share preview card
findings.internal_detail: Add Open Graph tags (title, description, image) with a branded share image.
findings.client_summary: When the site's link is shared on WhatsApp or Facebook, no preview card appears.

findings.title: No structured data anywhere
findings.internal_detail: Add Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD, plus FAQPage/Product/Service types where content exists.
findings.client_summary: The site never introduces itself to Google in the structured form rich results are built from.

findings.title: Business contact details missing: address, phone, email
findings.evidence: Rendered text contains no recognisable address or phone or email
findings.internal_detail: Publish full NAP (name, address, phone) in the footer and contact page; add email.
findings.client_summary: The details both Google and careful customers look for are not published on the site.

findings.title: Google Business Profile could not be confirmed
findings.evidence: Requires owner confirmation or profile access to verify either way
findings.internal_detail: Confirm with the client; if absent, create and verify a GBP for the service area.
findings.client_summary: Whether the business appears on Google's local map could not be confirmed from outside.

findings.title: Backlink profile not assessed
findings.evidence: Requires a backlink data provider (deferred integration)
findings.internal_detail: Assess via Ahrefs/DataForSEO when the integration is added.
findings.client_summary: Who links to the site - a major trust signal - needs a dedicated data source to measure.

findings.title: The domain carries no Malaysian signal
findings.internal_detail: Consider .com.my/.my (requires SSM), cheapest while the site is young; weigh against existing equity.
findings.client_summary: The web address itself tells Google nothing about serving Malaysia, unlike competitors on local domains.

findings.title: Only one way to make contact
findings.internal_detail: Add at least one more route (phone + email at minimum); larger customers often cannot use chat apps.
findings.client_summary: Visitors who cannot or will not use that one channel have no way to reach the business.
